newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Canadian economy starting to expand - BOC's Thiessen.
newsitem.headline: Canadian economy starting to expand - BOC's Thiessen.

text.p: Bank of Canada Governor Gordon Thiessen said the Canadian economy was starting to expand and he expected a strengthening during the rest of 1997.
On Friday, Canada reported an unchanged unemployment rate of 9.7 percent in February.
Asked about the employment data, Thiessen said: "There is no doubt it (the economy) is starting to expand but employment is a lagging indicator which is coming through slowly."
"I expect a strong economy during the rest of 1997."
